newsitem.title: UK: BT set for radical internal change - report.
newsitem.headline: BT set for radical internal change - report.

text.p: British Telecom is to implement a radical plan to split its internal structure into 40 or 50 separate business units, the Independent reported on Thursday.

The report said that BT was planning to introduce a full-scale internal market following a dramatic programme of staff cuts which has seen the workforce shrink from 240,000 to 125,000 over the past seven years.
Each division will act as a stand-alone business with its own profit and loss account and the right to outsource some operations to other companies.
The Independent quoted BT as saying that the aim was not to reduce staff levels further and that there were no specific targets for cost savings.
